boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten campus places with documented student uses, from reservable study rooms and support lounges to outdoor gathering and volunteer spaces.

cards.title: Put the Group Project on a Big Screen
cards.subtitle: Reservable rooms 123–126 inside Pearson Library
cards.notes: Reserve a two-hour block, check in at the circulation desk with your student ID, and bring cables or borrow adapters there.
cards.short_summary: Four small rooms combine a PC, monitor, dry-erase board, and screen-sharing connection for individual or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran states that Pearson Library study rooms 123–126 are open to students, faculty, and staff, with students receiving priority; each has a PC, dry-erase board, TV monitor, and HDMI connection.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are offered in two-hour blocks during regular library hours. Patrons check in at the circulation desk and leave a student ID for the booking.

cards.title: Bring the Draft Before It Feels Finished
cards.subtitle: Peer feedback and study space in Pearson Library 132
cards.notes: Bring the prompt, course materials, and specific questions for a consultation, or use the computer stations and seating for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative room where Cal Lutheran writers can workshop projects at any stage or settle in for independent study.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies the Writing Center as a collaborative space in Pearson Library 132 offering peer consultations, workshops, computer stations, comfortable chairs, and use as a study space.
cards.source_title: Overview | The Writing Center at Cal Lutheran
cards.access_notes: Located in Pearson Library 132. The posted regular hours are Monday–Friday, noon–5 p.m., with additional hours shown in the appointment schedule.

cards.title: Reset Between Classes Without Leaving Campus
cards.subtitle: A student-centered gathering place at 3391 Mountclef Boulevard
cards.notes: Use the workstations for a quick task, ask the Info Desk about equipment, or meet classmates in a first-come, first-served room.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub combines places to relax and socialize with workstations, games, meeting rooms, charging, and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran describes the Student Union as a place to play, socialize, relax, spend time between classes, use workstations, attend events, and access student services.
cards.access_notes: Located at 3391 Mountclef Blvd. Building access during open hours requires a student ID card; consult the Union's current hours page before visiting.

cards.title: Meet Friends Around a Movie or a Game
cards.subtitle: Community lounge on the Student Union’s lower level
cards.notes: Drop in to talk with the CCEI team, use the comfortable seating, browse educational materials, or play Nintendo Switch with friends.
cards.short_summary: A staffed community lounge pairs casual seating and entertainment with materials and culturally focused programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran says the lower-level CCEI Lounge is a space where students can relax, connect, and build community, with seating, educational materials, movies, and a Nintendo Switch.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Student Union's lower level. The CCEI office and lounge post Monday–Friday hours of 8 a.m.–5 p.m. and close on weekends and holidays.

cards.title: Build a Deliberate Pause Into the Day
cards.subtitle: Low-stimulation space in Student Union room 205B
cards.notes: Follow signs from the Union entrance, then use the modular seating for a quiet break or a study session between commitments.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor room provides massage chairs, a tea bar, snacks, wellness resources, and flexible seating for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran identifies the Wellness Lounge in Student Union room 205B as a student space for rest, recharging, studying, and reconnecting, with modular seating and wellness amenities.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Student Union's second floor in room 205B and accessible by elevator or stairs. Posted hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Choose a Lower-Sensory Place to Regroup
cards.subtitle: A private sensory-friendly room in the Student Union
cards.notes: Ask the Student Union Info Desk how to access the room, then use its soft lighting and weighted blankets for a quiet reset.
cards.short_summary: This intentionally low-sensory space supports rest and reflection, particularly for neurodiverse students and others seeking sensory relief.
cards.evidence_claim: The university lists The Den among Student Union amenities and describes it as a private, low-sensory space with weighted blankets, soft lighting, and calming visuals.
cards.access_notes: The official amenities page does not publish separate access hours or a room number; ask the Student Union Info Desk for current access details.

cards.title: Trade Screen Time for a Garden Shift
cards.subtitle: Sustainable Edible Education space north of Hutton Field
cards.notes: Check the garden’s Instagram for current drop-in volunteer times, or contact the program to arrange a tour or student event.
cards.short_summary: A working campus garden functions as an outdoor classroom, living lab, volunteer site, and gathering place.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran says the SEEd Project Garden is open for use by students and community members, hosts student-worker drop-in volunteer hours, and supports classes, research, tours, and events.
cards.access_notes: The garden is on north campus beyond Hutton Field. Volunteer days and times change and are announced through the garden's official Instagram account.

cards.title: Take the Gathering Outside Under the Trees
cards.subtitle: Central-campus lawn divided by Kingsmen Creek
cards.notes: Use the shaded park as an event meetup point, and check the campus calendar or venue schedule before planning around a large gathering.
cards.short_summary: A central green space with shade trees and a creek accommodates a range of university outdoor events.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran's venue page places Kingsmen Park in the center of campus and states that it is used for varied outdoor events, with Kingsmen Creek running between large shade-bearing trees.
cards.source_title: Kingsmen Park | Venue Detail | Cal Lutheran
cards.access_notes: Outdoor venue availability can change for scheduled events. Formal event bookings and associated charges are handled through Campus Services.

cards.entity_name: Alexander Twilight Legacy of Black Excellence Lounge
cards.title: Connect in a Space Shaped by Student Advocacy
cards.subtitle: Supportive community room inside the Student Union
cards.notes: Check the CCEI program calendar or email the center before visiting for a scheduled gathering, club meeting, or community program.
cards.short_summary: Black student advocacy helped establish this named lounge for connection, belonging, and community-building.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran describes the Alexander Twilight Legacy of Black Excellence Lounge as an open, supportive community space serving Cal Lutheran's Black student community and credits Black Student Union and Sisters' Circle advocacy for its creation.
cards.source_title: The Alexander Twilight Legacy of Black Excellence | Cal Lutheran
cards.access_notes: Located in the Student Union. Program schedules are maintained by CCEI; contact the center for current room access and event information.

cards.title: Move a Club Conversation Into the Open Air
cards.subtitle: Student-created patio outside the Student Union’s upper level
cards.notes: Use the patio when no program is scheduled, or email CCEI ahead of time to request a reservation or accessibility support.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor gathering area created with student-government involvement gives culture and justice clubs room to meet and host programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran states that the CCEI Patio was created with ASCLUG and student-life partners, is located outside the Student Union's upper level, and can be reserved by culture and justice clubs.
cards.access_notes: Located outside the upper level of the Student Union near Mt. Clef Residence Hall. Email CCEI for reservations and accessibility requests.
